subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: Newspapers gives us news of home and abroad It shows that it has useful to all sections of people They are great educative value too present really a part and parcel of our life us the outside world like a mirror
guide_solution: (a) Newspapers are useful to all sections of people. (b) It shows that it has great educative value too. (c) Newspapers present us the outside world like a mirror. (d) They are really part and parcel of our life. (e) It gives us news of home and abroad.
